package.description: A modern TeX distribution for Windows, Linux and macOS.

en-US.description: A modern TeX distribution for Windows, Linux and macOS.
en-US.longDescription:
MiKTeX is a modern TeX distribution for Windows, Linux and macOS.
MiKTeX's integrated package manager installs missing components from the Internet, if required. This allows you to keep your TeX installation as minimal as possible (“Just enough TeX”).
MiKTeX is open source. You are welcome to redistribute MiKTeX under certain conditions.
en-US.name: MiKTeX

zh-CN.description: A modern TeX distribution for Windows, Linux and macOS.
zh-CN.longDescription:
MiKTeX 是一款适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 的现代 TeX 发行版。
MiKTeX 的集成软件包管理器会按需从互联网上安装缺失的组件，从而能够尽可能减少 TeX 安装（“只需充足的 TeX”）。
MiKTeX 是开源软件，您可以在一定条件下再分发 MiKTeX。
zh-CN.name: MiKTeX
